title: Tanker Prospects
summary: Poten & Partners is pleased to announce the publication of Tanker Prospects (2006 - 2010). The 192-page report covers our assessment of the prospects for VLCCs, Suezmaxes, Aframaxes, Panamaxes, and Handymaxes through 2010. For this publication, we have had to take a new approach to assessing VLCC demand.
